plugins.name: sync-skills
plugins.description: Reconcile skills between ~/.agents/skills/ (authoritative) and ~/.claude/skills/ (runtime) — handle junctions, migrations, and lockfile backfill on Windows/macOS/Linux.

plugins.name: speedpr
plugins.description: Drive the current branch to 'Ready To Merge': detect phase A→B→C→D, handle review threads (GraphQL), CI, and merge conflicts. Supports /loop for polling and an `auto` mode for merging.
